entries.prompt: A handful of hard resin polyhedral tabletop dice tumble into a shallow leather-lined wooden dice tray. Distinct irregular clacks and small bounces slow down and settle naturally. Close dry Foley, intimate tabletop scale, one roll lasting about 1.3 seconds. No voices, music, coins, glass, room ambience or added magical sounds.
